objects.name: account
objects.description: A member's account, a structure's contribution basket, a paybill, a bank, or the suspense account an unmatched statement row lands in until somebody claims it.

objects.name: entry
objects.description: One movement of money in the contribution ledger: a contribution posted, a handout issued, an import matched, a correction reversing any of them.

objects.name: budget
objects.description: What a basket or an account is expected to collect or spend over one period, read against what was actually posted.

objects.name: milestone
objects.description: A stage of a contract that a ward's budget line pays for.

objects.name: certificate
objects.description: A payment certificate for a milestone, with the retention it withheld.

objects.name: tender
objects.description: A request to buy something against a budget line, answered by quotes.

objects.name: quote
objects.description: One supplier's offer for a tender.

objects.name: upward_report
objects.description: A financial report as it stood when it was sent upward.
